The '''Ansion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was home to six [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including its namesake [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] and [[Gaulix]].<ref name="TEA" />
